jobs.description:
PLANSEE
one strong group

Was uns stark macht? Unsere Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter in 50 Ländern weltweit, die täglich mit Leidenschaft an innovativen Lösungen aus Wolfram und Molybdän für die Hightech-Welt arbeiten.

Unser Standort in Reutte ist der Hauptsitz und größte Produktionsstandort der Plansee Gruppe. Hier sind die Geschäftsbereiche Plansee und CERATIZIT sowie zentrale Konzernfunktionen angesiedelt, die Innovationen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette der Pulvermetallurgie umsetzen.

Werden Sie Teil eines hochmotivierten Teams, das lokale Stärken in Reutte, Österreich mit dem globalen Wissen und den Werten der Plansee Gruppe verbindet. 1 Procurement Process Specialist (m/w/d) Your tasks:

You support the optimization and standardization of our source-to-pay processes across the global organization. In close collaboration with procurement and finance experts and cross-functional teams, you contribute to improving efficiency, supporting system enhancements and driving process excellence initiatives.

 * Supporting the analysis, documentation and continuous improvement of global procurement processes in collaboration with procurement, IT, supply chain and finance teams

 * Assisting in the implementation and rollout of standardized procurement processes, tools and best practices across the organization

 * Preparing and analyze procurement data to identify trends, process optimization opportunities and support reporting activities

 * Contributing to the implementation and further development of procurement technologies, including e-procurement solutions and electronic data exchange (EDI)

 * Supporting procurement-related projects, such as system implementations, testing activities, training coordination and process rollouts as well as creating process documentation, user guides and training materials, and provide support to end users

Your profile:

 * Bachelor's degree in Business economics, Supply Chain Management or a related field

 * Initial professional experience in procurement, finance, process management or a comparable function in an international environment

 * Good understanding of SAP, ideally within the MM module, and interest in procurement-related systems and digitalization

 * Strong analytical skills, structured working style and attention to detail, while keeping the big picture

 * Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams and fluency in English; additional languages such as French or German are considered an advantage

Strong benefits:

 * Opportunity to contribute to the optimization of procurement processes within a global organization

 * Work in an international environment with exposure to various procurement functions and stakeholders worldwide

 * Professional development opportunities and the chance to further build expertise in procurement processes and systems

 * Participation in international projects and digital transformation initiatives

 * Flexible working hours, remote work options and attractive social benefits

Legally required notice in case of an employment in Austria: Minimum salary according to the collective agreement for the IT industry (ST1) is € 45.738,- gross per year, paid over 14 installments.The actual offer takes market prices, qualifications and professional experience into account.
